# Sound coverage

Where every sound in the game comes from, after the Sonniss GDC 2026 pass (2026-11-13).

**Priority:** the team's own recordings always come first ([original_recordings.csv](../../game/audio/original_recordings.csv)).
Sonniss only fills places that had no sound or a synthesized/Kenney placeholder; no own recording was replaced.

Sources: **Own** = the team's recordings · **Sonniss** = cut from the GDC 2026 bundle ([sonniss_sources.csv](sonniss_sources.csv)) ·
**Kenney** = Kenney CC0 packs (`audio/sfx/`) · **Synth** = generated by `audio/tools/generate_*.py` · **None** = silent.
"Was" shows what played before this pass.

## Movement and the body

| Place | Source | Was | Files / notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Footsteps on grass, snow, wood, rock | Kenney | Kenney | `sfx/kenney_impact_sounds/footstep_*` (Footsteps) |
| Footsteps on scree, mud | Synth | Synth | `footsteps/scree_*`, `mud_*`; **gap**: nothing fitting in the bundle |
| Landing (soft, hard) | Kenney | Kenney | impactSoft (SoundEffects `land`, `land_hard`) |
| Falling down (downed, ragdoll) | Kenney | Kenney | impactPunch heavy (`fall`) |
| Thrown through the air (Launched) | Sonniss | None | `sonniss/foley/launch_whoosh.ogg` |
| Caught in a spider web (Snared) | Sonniss | None | `sonniss/creatures/web_snare_0.ogg` |
| The carrier's own voice (pain, effort, breath) | None | None | **gap**: should be an own recording |

## What the bundle is still missing

The GDC 2026 bundle on disk (Part 9, 347 WAVs in 125 library folders, 7.5 GB) matches its filelist, but
29 files have stretches of zero bytes (torrent pieces not downloaded yet; `status = holes` in
[sonniss_gdc2026_index.csv](sonniss_gdc2026_index.csv)). None of them was used. Re-run
`audio/tools/index_sonniss.py` once the download finishes.

Still wanted from later parts or our own recordings: scree, gravel and mud footsteps; the carrier's voice
(efforts, pain, breath; best recorded by the team); a wolf howl; farm animals; a sword drawn and sheathed;
chewing and sipping; a soft chime for a new goal.

## Size

54 clips, 5.0 MB of Ogg Vorbis (44.1 kHz; one-shots mono, beds and weather stereo). The synthesized
wind, rain and fire loops and the replaced synthesized sword and beast clips (7.3 MB of WAV, all
unreferenced now) were removed, so the build is about 2.3 MB smaller than before; their generators in
`audio/tools/` can make them again.
